title: Efficient-score domination: exact gap and equality conditions
statement: Var(E[S_hat|q]) - S_psi^+(I_q) = (B*_full - B*_q) I^q_ll (B*_full - B*_q)^T exactly; equality for fixed q iff (B*_full - B*_q) I^q_ll = 0 (the full-data nuisance projection is binned-optimal); along partition sequences refining to the Borel sigma-field the gap vanishes. Equality behavior at global optima remains open (OPEN-DS-MARGINS-AT-OPTIMA).

proof_location.section: DS11. Variational form of the profiled objective
